data.rationale: Commit 30d4a6daac8b updates how PostgreSQL parses XML data in CONTENT mode by switching from xmlParseBalancedChunkMemory to xmlParseInNodeContext with XML_PARSE_NOBLANKS enabled. This affects xml_parse, xmlparse, xmlserialize, xml_is_document, xml_doctype_in_content, and wellformed_xml when processing XML in CONTENT mode or validating DOCUMENT/CONTENT well-formedness. The grammar changes introduce constructs for XMLPARSE in CONTENT/DOCUMENT modes, XMLSERIALIZE formatting, and expressions involving the IS DOCUMENT predicate and XML content validation functions. These reach the updated libxml2 parsing paths and error checks in src/backend/utils/adt/xml.c.
seeds: SELECT XMLPARSE(CONTENT '<?xml version="1.0"?>' || chr(65279) || 'abc') IS DOCUMENT;
SELECT XMLSERIALIZE(CONTENT XMLPARSE(CONTENT '12') AS text INDENT);
SELECT c1, XML_IS_WELLFORMED_CONTENT(c1), (c1::xml) IS DOCUMENT FROM t0 WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL;
